sections.Profile:
The "Lulu" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in December 1954, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, featuring artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1954
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Ice Skating, Wood Rail, Sports, Original Theme, Ice
sections.Design Team:
- Art: George Molentin
- Design: Harry Williams
